Definition: to flatten out or extend (as a tent); figuratively, to nurse a child (as promotive of growth);
BiblicalUsage: 1) to extend, spread, trip, take quick little steps; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to spread out; 1a2) to carry on the palms, dandle; 1a3) to rear children
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
